instruction: Generate report with timestamped filename
Automate weekly report generation with script
output:
cat > /usr/local/bin/goaccess-weekly.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
REPORT_DIR=/var/www/html/reports
mkdir -p $REPORT_DIR
goaccess /var/log/nginx/access.log -a -o $REPORT_DIR/report-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).html
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/goaccess-weekly.sh

instruction: Create systemd service for GoAccess daemon
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/goaccess.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=GoAccess Dashboard
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/goaccess /var/log/nginx/access.log --real-time-html -o /var/www/html/report.html
Restart=always
User=www-data
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
